v8_final_validation.measurement_scope: Actual non-practice Boss AI, scripted invulnerable player, isolated fixed30Hz Editor game capture. Bone coordinates and targets are world centimetres. CSV rounded to4 decimal places; skin-tip clearance comes from the FBX reference geometry and final hand orientation, not a live GPU-skinned-vertex query. visual_review.result: Front stroke retains a coherent overhead-to-front descent. In LowSide the near claw tip meets the paving in the impact/hold pose and lifts continuously by480; no broad floating hand or broad paving penetration is visible in those frames. The farther hand is partly occluded. Root separately confirms that Front470–474 no longer show the large recovery elbow roll. Independent QA late-recovery review remains pending at report write.
limits: Only fixed30Hz Boss fixture on flat paving assessed for Slam contact.
Individual digits have no articulated joints; the lowest rigid claw point contacts, not every fingertip or the full palm.
No claim of contact on all procedural slopes, teleports or arbitrary terrain.
